dct_description_sm: This study is aiming to reconstruct long-term archives of THg and FTHg with ice and snow samples from multi-sites of glaciers and/or ice caps in Greenland and in the Canadian High Arctic, and to investigate if THg archives are reproducible. Results achieved in this study will provide modellers real data sets of total mercury deposition history in the studied regions to test their models.
dct_title_s: Archives of total mercury reconstructed with ice and snow from Greenland and the Canadian High Arctic
